question: Which junction has the most unequal distribution of incoming traffic across its edges? For each non-internal junction with at least 2 incoming edges, compute the total vehicle count on each incoming edge (sum of all vehicle observations across all lanes and all timesteps in the FCD). Then compute the coefficient of variation (std / mean) of those totals. Report the junction with the highest CV. If multiple junctions tie at the highest CV, break the tie by the largest total incoming vehicle count, then by the lexicographically smallest junction ID. Answer format: <junction_id>
